0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who also have not played a game yet this season, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Cleveland a 40% chance to win. Cleveland is missing Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and Tacko Fall, who is day-to-day with a hip injury. Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 victory in Cleveland in the most recent meeting on March 9, 2026.
